summary: Independently checked the eight requested estimates against PDF pp. 8-15 (printed pp. 1030-1037), including every cited source page, and read the complete 124,086-character markdown conversion through the references. No incorrect statistic, count, arm attribution, or requested code was found. All 19 source quotations for these estimates are supported on their exact cited pages. All ten supplied quote-not-found flags are false negatives caused by PDF line wrapping, line-end hyphenation, ligatures, subscripts, and font mappings of the printed plus and less-than signs; relevant rendered PDF text was also inspected. Human fluency is U = 475.0, p = 0.015, rank-biserial r = -0.324; the additional positive converted d = 0.581 is printed and correctly retained in notes. Human GPT-4 value is U = 653.5, p = 0.602. Dyad fluency is U = 963.5, p = 0.006, r = 0.371; flexibility is U = 1080.0, p < 0.001, r = 0.536; judge-rated novelty has treatment mean 3.396, control mean 2.876, t(73) = 2.889, p = 0.005, d = 0.667; judge-rated value is U = 994.0, p = 0.002, r = 0.414. Dyad Good-Idea-Count is U = 1073.5 for novelty and U = 1095.5 for value, both p < 0.001. Reported medians are correctly kept in notes rather than mean fields. The seven n_total = 75 entries use the printed common analytic sample: no further participant exclusions are stated for human fluency or the dyad outcomes. The four additional exclusions concern human-origin shortlist quality, so the unprinted human GPT-4 value analysis count correctly remains null. Group sizes 38 and 37 are not labeled by arm, so named-arm counts correctly remain null. Each dyad contains one randomized human; participant unit and se_basis are appropriate. The requested question, construct, measure, higher_is, AI availability, timing, within-person, and comparison codes agree with the methods and codebook. No eligible outcome or contrast is missing from the available article: the extraction contains all eight main human/dyad outcomes, four GPT-4 shortlist-rating variants, and four Good-Idea-Count variants. Idea-origin comparisons, within-treatment correlations, and self-reports are appropriately excluded under rules 4-6. Coverage limitation: the saved PDF and markdown contain no online appendices or embedded supplement. No matching local supplement was located. Fresh urllib requests with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 to the named Springer supplementary-PDF URL and then the publisher article URL both failed with WinError 10013. Online Appendices A-E therefore remain unverified; no missing estimate is inferred from inaccessible material.
